title: Womb Wellness Workshop
description: A Continuing Education Workshop for yoga practitioners and community members.
long_description:
A Continuing Education Workshop for yoga practitioners and community members.

About this Event

Plenty of time to register for the SHINE With Joy Yoga Continuing Education Offering - open to ALL yogis ✨

The Womb Wellness Workshop was created with love and care, and is very near to our hearts at SWJ. Honoring the thoughtful tending of both physical and energetic differences of each individual in our community yoga spaces, helping women feel seen, safe, and cared for while they grow their yoga practices… these are in alignment with our mission to create positive change in the community!

And we will do just that in our workshop, with a lot of joy sprinkled in between ✨

Register now for this FREE workshop - 2 Yoga Alliance Continuing Education Hours will be awarded at the conclusion of the morning.

Link in our bio. We hope to see you there ✨
